# Contributing

Bug reports and pull requests are welcome.

- **Bugs:** use the bug report form and attach the files from **Share Logs**. A crash without
  logs is rarely actionable.
- **Pull requests:** one logical change each, with commit messages in
  [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) style (`fix: ...`,
  `feat: ...`). Fill in the PR template.
- **Building:** see [Building from source](../README.md#building-from-source).
  [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) has the conventions and the things that need a discussion first
  (signing, entitlements, workflows, submodule pointers).
- **Licence:** contributions are released under [GPL-3.0](../LICENSE), like the rest of the
  project.
